stage: pre-chroma standard rows; independent hash-bound final review still required

rows.idle: Six open-eye poses; quiet shoulder/hair variation, planted boots, close seam.
rows.running-right: Eight rightward poses with contact, passing and lift phases; knees alternate and arm pose changes; source order retained.
rows.running-left: Independently drawn leftward gait, not mirrored; opposite-facing head and complete boots; source order retained.
rows.waving: Prepare, raise, wrist gesture, lower to near rest; correct empty hand and preserved asymmetric hardware.
rows.jumping: Original compact arc recovered by shared viewport; head/torso match idle rather than growing during crouch. Boots rise and land, final bent knees are settling.
rows.failed: Standing surprise/disappointment and recovery, no collapse or detached symbols.
rows.waiting: Palm-up request and expectant tilt followed by recovery; feet fixed by reviewed source anchors.
rows.running: Thinking/processing chin gesture with planted boots, not locomotion or new tools.
rows.review: Downward inspection and small approving nod, recovery to neutral; bowed head is not independently enlarged.

accepted_warnings: Stable-slots/reviewed-layout replace per-frame fit after visible arc suppression, size changes or bbox-centering foot shift; all source cuts and scales retained.
Chroma fringe not judged before the single final edge pass.

timing.non_idle: version-specific usually three cycles then idle; source hold table
